findings.description: FYI: Ledger items 38 and 45 are resolved — task 2.5 Spec scenarios now include skill-workflow "Tree tool failure after fresh check", and `references/grounding.md` documents `--tree` spawn/unexpected-exit → `graph check failed`.
FYI: Ledger item 46 is resolved — task 2.6 Spec scenarios now list "Manifest declares portable distribution and atlas dependencies" and "Sibling skill paths use skill-base-dir form".

Nit: Ledger item 13 is `status: retired` with `parked_reason: disagreement` in `.review-ledger/ledger.json`, yet `reviews/parked-disagreements.json` still tracks ledger_id 13 as an active parked disagreement. The process records disagree on whether the item is closed or still parked (the open-item claim of `retired_reason: plan-review-adjudication-round-4` is not present on the ledger record).
findings.resolution: Either keep 13 parked and set ledger status to a non-retired parked state, or resolve/remove it from `parked-disagreements.json` and retire consistently; do not leave both "retired" and "actively parked".

findings.description: Nit: Atlas Symbol Tree Export SHALL resolve module targets by full file path or basename, but the only module scenario ("File target gives the aggregated module view") and task 1.1 / `test_basename_roots_at_module` cover basename only. There is also no scenario for unique-symbol-name-before-module when a unique name collides with a module path/basename. Same gap as parked item 13 and open items 40/50/51/52.
findings.resolution: Add codebase-analysis scenarios + task 1.1 tests for (1) full module file-path resolution distinct from basename and (2) unique name winning over module path/basename; keep basename scenario.

findings.description: Nit: Atlas Symbol Tree Export SHALL use only the Python standard library and make no network requests, but no WHEN/THEN scenario or task 1.x acceptance check verifies either constraint.
findings.resolution: Add a scenario and a deterministic test (e.g. parse `atlas_tree.py` imports / forbid non-stdlib modules) asserting stdlib-only and no network client usage; wire it into task 1.1 or 1.2.

findings.description: Nit: D5 / skill-workflow map `--check` spawn/OSError to `graph check failed`, but no scenario WHEN covers that path. "Stale or absent graph falls back to source" WHEN is only non-zero `--check` or missing script/graph (→ `graph stale` / `graph absent`), yet its THEN still allows `graph check failed`. "Tree tool failure after fresh check" covers only `--tree` after a successful check. `test_behaviour.py` only asserts the reason token exists.
findings.resolution: Add a dedicated "Check tool spawn failure" scenario (WHEN `--check` cannot be spawned/OSError → THEN `graph check failed`); remove `graph check failed` from the stale/absent THEN; extend task 2.2 to assert the check-spawn mapping text in grounding.md.

findings.description: Nit: Atlas requirement says every node line SHALL be `<name>  (<file>:<line>)  [<kind>]`, but "Callees tree for a symbol" validates that shape only for the root line, and task 1.1 / `TestPrintedNodesMatchFixture` checks descendants only by `(name, file)` — wrong line or kind on children would still pass.
findings.resolution: Extend the callees (or a dedicated format) scenario and `test_atlas_tree.py` so every emitted node is checked against fixture name, file, line, and kind.

findings.description: Nit: In `proposal.md` What Changes, the Frontmatter bullet lists six keys (`name, description, category, tags, user_invocable, related`) but then says the skill test asserts the "four surviving keys". Spec, tasks 2.1, D6, and `test_skill_md.py` all require explicit assertions for all six.
findings.resolution: Change "four surviving keys" to "six surviving keys" (or "all six declared keys") in proposal.md.
findings.existing_code: four surviving keys explicitly instead of calling the shared

findings.description: Nit: In `session-log.md` Plan Review, `### Next Steps` still sits between round-1 and round-2 decisions and tells the reader to IMPLEMENT if converged, while rounds 3–4 adjudications (converge-result cleanup, task 1.1 scenario extension, `--tree` → `graph check failed`, non-call-tree source read, proposal disclosure alignment; `plan_revision` → 6) live only in `plan-findings.md`.
findings.resolution: Move/update Plan Review Next Steps after the final adjudication decisions; append round 3–4 decisions into the session-log Plan Review section so it matches plan-findings.md.

findings.description: Nit: Plan Review decision 2 in `session-log.md` understates `graph check failed` as "spawn failure or `--tree` exit 1", while D5 and the skill-workflow requirement also map any `--tree` exit other than `0`/`2`/`3` (after a fresh `--check`) to that reason.
findings.resolution: Amend decision 2 to match the closed table: `--check` spawn/OSError; or after fresh `--check`, `--tree` spawn failure, exit `1`, or any exit other than `0`/`2`/`3`.

findings.description: Optional: Open item 52 claims design.md says task 1.1 covers file-path resolution; current design.md D4 only states path-or-basename resolution and task 1.1 text says "basename target". The missing full-path scenario is real (finding 5); the design-attribution half of item 52 is not accurate.
findings.resolution: Treat item 52 as duplicate of the path-resolution gap (finding 5); do not require a design.md claim that does not exist.
